packageRules.description: stable/9 and stable/10 are maintenance branches: patch updates only.
Do not raise routine major-update PRs. Renovate's vulnerability remediation bypasses packageRules by design, so a major is still raised when it is the lowest version that fixes a known vulnerability.
Auto-merge minor and patch updates once CI is green.

The generator writes the shipped SDK code, so a generator update changes the product, not a tool: never auto-merge it, and label it for review (#389). 0.29.0 emitted Python 3.11-only code into an SDK that supports 3.10. Must stay after the auto-merge rule. Security updates still auto-merge, because Renovate forces vulnerabilityAlerts over all packageRules; for those, the required CI checks are the gate.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Vulnerability fixes are user-facing: commit them as fix(deps) so semantic-release cuts a patch release on main and stable/*, and auto-merge once the required checks are green. Renovate appends this as the last package rule, so it overrides the chore commit type and the automerge/enabled rules above.
